overview_description.description: Stitch is a patient engagement platform that allows healthcare teams to deliver great patient experiences. Our mission is to improve patient experiences. Our customers are healthcare providers (doctors, nurses, social workers, pharmacists, etc.) and their patients. Stitch is based in San Francisco, CA and is backed by some of the world's best investors, including Benchmark Capital and Y Combinator.
